title: Quick Crisp Yellow Pepper Moroccan Lamb Rfissa
description: A low-fat Moroccan dish made with crispy lamb, yellow pepper, and served in a pandan leaf wrap. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, mix together the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the lamb to a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced yellow bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Crush the garlic and onion with a mortar and pestle.
Add the crushed garlic and onion to the skillet with the yellow peppers and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Warm the pandan leaves by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
To assemble the rfissa, place a portion of the cooked lamb on a pandan leaf, followed by a spoonful of the yellow pepper mixture. Fold the pandan leaf to enclose and serve immediately.
